summary: Both archive and restore directions assert real equality on all 5 conjuncts (id-based lookup for identity, array-membership checks for project/Quick association, filePath equality, cachedTranscript equality, isPinned equality covering both true/false), against real Session structs with no mocking; each is a genuine counterexample-rejecting check given Session.id is immutable and archive/unarchive mutate the struct in place.
